overfitting.method: Clear signs require both validation and test rates >=5 percentage points below training AND both BCE losses >=25% above training. Either signal alone gives possible overfitting.
overfitting.limitation: Descriptive heuristic, not proof. No clear evidence does not imply predictive skill; chance variation, dataset differences and repeated tuning can affect gaps.

model.historical_score_note: The test set was used to select this model. These are historical tuning scores, not future performance.
